name: Saimin Gakkyuu
source:
Kazuki has the special power of hypnotism. Due to this power, it was really hard for him to live a normal life. What saved him was an organization of hypnotists. One day, he receives a command, "Sneak into a school and hypnotize all the students...." It will be easy if he is given enough time. However, he needs to complete his mission within two weeks this time....
